description: The ordinary new game: the tables and world the importer writes from the operator's own installation, and the authored opening that puts a newly created party at the start of the first region.
setup: This game's tables and world are generated from your own copy of Might and Magic VII and are not shipped. Build the importer and write them into the content root: dotnet build src/MightAndMagic7.Import.Tool -c Release, then dotnet src/MightAndMagic7.Import.Tool/bin/Release/net10.0/mm7import.dll write --install /path/to/your/mm7 --output content/partyrpg/imports. Restart the product once mm7-tables and mm7-world exist.
